about.label: About
about.title: Who is Leonardo Santos?
about.paragraph1: Full Stack Software Developer with a strong focus on clean architecture, Clean Code, and delivering efficient end-to-end solutions. I have solid experience in the JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystem, building robust RESTful APIs with Node.js and NestJS as well as modern, fluid interfaces with React and React Native (Expo).
about.paragraph2: I have solid experience with relational databases — PostgreSQL and MySQL — Prisma ORM, and Docker containerization. I hold a degree in Computer Science from Estácio de Sá and combine this technical foundation with a focus on Clean Code, clean architecture, and best practices.

skills.aiTitle: Productivity in the age of AI
skills.aiManifesto: AI is here to revolutionize software development and accelerate our deliveries. I use it to improve my productivity, explore ideas, and learn faster, but I do not delegate to AI what I do not understand. I see AI as a private tutor: I question, study, test, and validate its answers. It is not about asking AI to do everything and accepting every result, but about using it with curiosity, critical thinking, and responsibility to grow as a developer.

projectDescriptions.curiosity: Mobile application that consumes NASA data to present a dynamic space gallery, with image search, efficient image loading, and a simple experience for exploring different space records and content.
projectDescriptions.banking: API for managing banking transactions, featuring JWT authentication, data persistence, and integration with AWS services. It includes rules for creating and querying transactions, user organization, and a structure prepared to evolve securely and at scale.
projectDescriptions.birdai: Mobile bird catalog interface connected to a full-stack solution, combining species exploration, organized data, and backend integration. The application is designed to make bird discovery easier while keeping navigation clear across devices.
projectDescriptions.testCorrections: API for creating and correcting tests, with grade generation, authentication, and structured persistence using Prisma. It organizes the assessment workflow and centralizes the rules for registering questions, answers, and results.
projectDescriptions.worldCupStickers: API for organizing a World Cup sticker collection, allowing users to register, browse, and manage their collection in a structured way. It helps track collected and missing stickers with persisted data and protected access.

about.label: About
about.title: Who is Leonardo Santos?
about.paragraph1: Full Stack Developer | From Rio de Janeiro | 24 years old. My journey in technology began at the start of 2022, when I discovered that creating software was exactly what I wanted to do with my life. Since then, I graduated in Computer Science from Estácio and have been dedicated to delivering efficient solutions from the database to the user interface.
about.paragraph2: I believe good code is clean code. That is why I apply Clean Code and Clean Architecture principles in my daily work, along with experience in PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma ORM, and Docker. More than writing lines of code, driven by daily curiosity, my goal is to transform complex ideas into efficient, elegant solutions that truly make a difference.
